title: Sarbacher's secret atomic lab in Washington DC

tellings.quote: It was published in the paper that he had asked for a renewal of a permit to pursue atomic research at this residential address in Washington DC,

plain: In the 1950s a scientist named Robert Sarbacher is said to have run atomic research out of an ordinary house in Washington DC, and a newspaper reported that he had asked to renew a permit for it at that home address. Jan Lundquist, a researcher in a documentary about an inventor named Townsend Brown, tells this on the show. If true, it would mean secret atomic work was going on in a private house in the capital.
